name: Blush Pink
lede: Blush pink is a warm coral-leaning pink named for the color that rises in the cheeks when someone blushes.

sections.title: The color of a flush
sections.body:
Paterson defines the verb *blush* as to change one's complexion when embarrassed, stressed or angry, and the color *blush* as red-colored [1]. He calls blush pink a delicate pink, and blush rose a delicate pink that may also be a dark shade of rose [1]. His indexes file blush pink under the pinks [2].

The dictionary's "delicate" is paler than this swatch, which is a stronger coral-leaning pink [3]. Paterson's wording is only "delicate," so the exact paleness is left open [1].

sections.title: Neighbors
sections.body: Close relatives are [[pink]], [[rose]] and the deeper reds [[red]] [3]. The library's nearest name is Pink at 8.6 units of color difference [3]. In LCH terms the swatch measures lightness 67, chroma 54 and hue 13 degrees, a fairly saturated pink [3]. A screen shows it only approximately [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this exact pink in no painting, as photographed [4].
